verdict.rationale: Webhook event subscriptions are a fair capability to ask of an observability platform, but the evidence never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The closest item (elastic-docs-22) only says alerts can send notifications via services or third-party incident management systems. That is an adjacent notification feature, not a documented webhook a programmatic consumer can register and receive.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
